name: CV Kinetics
description: Analyze multi-scan-rate cyclic voltammetry with b-value fitting and Dunn contribution analysis. Some online features and updates are missing; the offline version is more complete. Offline downloads are temporarily unavailable.
features: Browser-based CSV, TXT and XLSX import for multi-scan-rate CV data
b-value analysis and peak selection with manual adjustment
Dunn contribution analysis, diagnostic plots and result exports
Online version: some features are missing and some updates have not yet been synchronized
Offline version: a more complete workflow; current Windows release v2.1.7, with historical macOS v1.0.0 packages
Offline version history is available for reference; downloads are temporarily unavailable
